a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the operate-until-8 plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead, since a storm will likely hit before the reserve ever reaches 8. So I'm departing from the agreement and taking 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than doing it silently. If you take too, the split is random. Afterward I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more cells.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
